question_text: A repair centre processes urgent safety faults before routine jobs, regardless of arrival time. Explain why an ordinary FIFO queue is unsuitable.
adaptation_rationale: Selecting a FIFO queue for a specific problem is explicit. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: FIFO serves earliest arrival first; an urgent later job would wait behind routine jobs; priority-dependent insertion/service is needed instead.

marking_points.criterion: Later urgent item delayed by earlier routine items.
Links needed priority order to mismatch with ordinary FIFO.
